'''Pirdia''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tyrius/Legends|Tyrius]] in the [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]],<ref name="SE" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Pirdia was a ringed [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with green-blue [[Gas/Legends|gases]] striping its surface.<ref name="SE" /> Along with [[Toosma]], it was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system,<ref name="SE" /><ref name="EA" /> but Pirdia was smaller in size.<ref name="SE" />

Around Pirdia orbited eleven [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="SE" /><ref name="EA" /> which were occasionally [[Miner/Legends|mined]] by the weapons companies of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], the native [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Rodia/Legends|only habitable planet]] in the Tyrius system.<ref name="SE" /> In [[3638 BBY]], gas miners on Pirdia stumbled upon a long-abandoned [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Tyrius system/Legends|Tyrius system]], except [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], were first introduced in the [[1996]] sourcebook ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''.<ref name="SE" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Tyrius star system in grid square R-16.<ref name="EA" />
